Sky Smart Home FAQs

Answers to your questions and other helpful things.

  • Sky Smart Home makes your home smarter and more connected, so you never miss a moment, even when you’re away.

    You can get started with the Smart Doorbell and Smart Home Plan.

    Or the Smart Home Bundle, which includes the Smart Doorbell and an Indoor Camera. The bundle requires a Smart Home Plan +.

    Both plans unlock a range of useful features for your Smart Tech, including Video Recording, Cloud Storage, Smart Alerts and more.

    With Smart Home Plan + you can add more Smart Tech, like the Leak Pack, Motion Pack or another Indoor Camera to your setup.

    Everything works seamlessly together and is easily managed through the Sky Smart Home app.

  • See who’s at the door from your phone and talk to visitors with your Smart Doorbell and Smart Home Plan. The Smart Home Plan includes features like:

    • Video Recording
    • Clip Sharing
    • Cloud Storage
    • Custom Activity Zones
    • Smart Alerts, and more

    Your Smart Doorbell comes with cables and a mounting pack to make set-up easy. You’ll also get a Chime, included at no extra cost, so you never miss a ding dong, anywhere in your home.

  • The Indoor Camera is only available in the Smart Home Bundle, which includes the Smart Doorbell, Chime, and Indoor Camera.

    To use these devices together and unlock all features, you’ll need the Smart Home Plan +.

    The Smart Home Plan + includes features like:

    • Video Recording
    • Clip Sharing
    • Cloud Storage
    • Custom Activity Zones
    • Motion and Noise Alerts
    • Auto-Arming

    It also gives you the flexibility to add more Smart Tech, like Leak Pack, Motion Pack, and an extra Indoor Camera.

  • You need the Smart Home Plan with the Smart Doorbell. It unlocks all the smart features for the Smart Doorbell, including Video Recording, clip Sharing, Cloud Storage, Smart Alerts, Activity Zones, and more.

    If you want additional Smart Tech, such as the Indoor Camera, Leak Pack or Motion Pack, you’ll need to upgrade to Smart Home Plan +. It includes everything in the Smart Home Plan, plus the flexibility to add more Smart Tech. It also enables Away Mode with Auto-Arming for added control and privacy.

  • Just download the Smart Home app and follow the steps to connect your Smart Tech.

    Once connected, you can personalise your settings, like Alerts and Auto-Arming directly in the Smart Home app.

  • When you get the Smart Home Bundle and Smart Home Plan +, you unlock the ability to add more Smart Tech, like the Leak Pack, Motion Pack, and an extra Indoor Camera.

    • The Leak Pack includes three Leak Sensors.
    • The Motion Pack includes a Motion Sensor and two Contact Sensors.

    Both packs include a Sensor Bridge that gets all the tech talking to each other.

  • If you cancel your plan, you’ll lose all Smart Home Plan or Smart Home Plan + features. Your Smart Tech will revert to working with only basic features.

    If the cancellation is outside the cooling-off period, early termination charges may apply.

  • Our Smart Doorbell and Indoor Camera use encrypted video, two-step verification, and enhanced account security to help protect your privacy.

    All your video clips are safely stored in the cloud for 30 days. You can review them anytime with peace of mind.

    We also provide automatic security updates when required, keeping your devices protected and up to date.
